units: <cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 3:2">ib. III, 2</cite>) <he>כל שצָמְקָה וכ׳</he> an animal whose lungs are shrunk; Tosef. ib. III, 12 <he>שצְמוּקָה</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>שצמקה</he>).
<cite ref="Shabbat 91a:6">Sabb. 91ᵃ</cite> <he>צמקה וחזרה וכ׳</he> it shrank (became less than the size of a dry fig) and then swelled again.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Orlah 1:3:13">Y. Orl. I, 61ᵇ</cite> top <he>אם צָמְקוּ</he> if the grapes are shrunk (dried).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 2:2:4">Y. Ter. II, 41ᵈ</cite> top <he>לִצְמוֹק</he>, v. <cite ref="V00813"><he>תֶּפַח</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 31">Gen. R. s. 31</cite> <he>יִצְמוֹק</he>, v. <cite ref="C00454"><he>גָּוַע</he></cite>; a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="R00563"><he>צָמוּק</he></cite>; f. <he>צְמוּקָה</he>, v. supra.

senses.gloss: to cause shrinking; to dry (in the sun). Y. Maasr. IV, 51ᵇ top פדייו וצִימְּקוֹ if he redeemed it (when fresh), and let it dry. Y. Naz. VI, 55ᶜ צימיקו (read: צִימֵּיקָן); a. e.—Part. pass. מְצוּמָּק; f. מְצוּמֶּקֶת; pl. מְצוּמָּקִים; מְצוּמָּקוֹת.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 38a:9">Sabb. 38ᵃ</cite> <he>ביצים מצ׳</he> eggs boiled or roasted down to a small size.

senses.gloss: to be reduced in size (through boiling &c.). Ib. המִצְטַמֵּק ורע לו a dish which is deteriorated by boiling down; ib. מִצְטַמְּקוֹת ויפה להן eggs are improved by &c. Ib. 37ᵇ. Y. ib. III, 5ᵈ; a. fr.
